text: I think you'll really enjoy this Creamy Oven-Baked Risotto recipe. It's a comforting, creamy dish that's perfect for a weeknight dinner. Given your fondness for midwestern-style recipes and casseroles, I think you'll appreciate the simplicity and heartiness of this risotto. The addition of mushrooms and parmesan cheese adds a rich, savory flavor that's sure to please. Plus, it's ready in just about 40 minutes, which fits within your typical cooking time. Give it a try and see what you think!
